summary: [standards] --ignore-submodules=none in DIFF_SHAPE and STATUS_SHAPE (the two calls that feed the context pack state) is proven by no test: the fixture of 04/05 (dirty_project) has no submodule, so the matrix row diff.ignoreSubmodules=all is vacuous for the pack, and 06 reaches only NAMES_SHAPE (staleness names). Mutation run in a copy of d4f00082a: dropping the option from both constants (and, in the same build, emptying the env removal and NAMES_SHAPE) leaves 04 and 05 green while 01 and 06 go red, so only the other two mutations are killed. The code is right (probe: a moved submodule under diff.ignoreSubmodules=all gives the plain digest on 0.40 and a different one on 0.39.1), the check does not prove it. Other pinned options no matrix row kills (measured on plain git with the 04 fixture): --inter-hunk-context=0, --diff-algorithm=myers, --no-relative (git runs at the repo root, so diff.relative=true cannot show), --no-branch, and --no-color (redundant after -c color.ui=false); the brief lists them, but each is unexercised. Fix: put a submodule with an uncommitted pointer move into dirty_project (or a second fixture) and add rows for diff.interHunkContext, diff.algorithm, status.branch. Blast radius: a regression that drops the option would make a dirty pack's id depend on diff.ignoreSubmodules again with every check green.
